title: FalMcpModelsConfig
description: Schema for fal-mcp models.json — catalog of favorite fal.ai image models with pricing, endpoints and capabilities.

queue_base_url.description: Base URL for the fal queue API.

sync_base_url.description: Base URL for the fal sync (run) API.

default.description: Default model ID used when no model is specified.

default_text_to_image.description: Optional override: default model ID for text-to-image tasks.

default_edit_image.description: Optional override: default model ID for edit/refine tasks.

models.description: Map of model ID to model object.

use_case_routing.description: Map of use-case key to recommended model ID (or routing note).

common_aspect_ratios.description: Map of human-readable name to aspect ratio string.

auth.description: Authentication configuration for the fal API.

env_var.description: Primary environment variable name that holds the API key.

fallback_env_vars.description: Fallback environment variable names tried in order if the primary is unset.

FavoriteModel.description: A single favorite/curated fal.ai model entry.

id.description: Stable short identifier for this model (matches the map key).

vendor.description: Vendor/organization that produced the model, e.g. openai, google, xai.

use_cases.description: Short phrases describing ideal use cases.

default_params.description: Default request parameters to pass to the fal endpoint.

docs.description: URL to the model's fal.ai documentation page.

ModelEndpoints.description: fal endpoint path(s) for this model.

resize.description: Endpoint path for smart resize / recompose.

ModelPricing.description: Pricing information. Fields may be a flat number per image, an object map of size/quality keys to numbers, a per-megapixel rate, or a first_mp/extra_mp ladder.

t2i_usd_per_image.description: Cost per generated image — either a flat number or a map of size/quality tier keys to USD amounts.

edit_usd_per_image.description: Cost per edited image — either a flat number or a map of size/quality tier keys to USD amounts.

t2i_usd_per_megapixel.description: Cost per megapixel for text-to-image — flat number or {first_mp, extra_mp} ladder.

edit_usd_per_megapixel.description: Cost per megapixel for edit — flat number or {first_mp, extra_mp} ladder.

resize_usd_per_image_4k.description: Flat cost per smart-resize call at 4K.

min_vision_fee_usd.description: Minimum vision-analysis fee added to resize jobs.

upscale_usd_per_megapixel.description: Cost per output megapixel for upscalers.

upscale_usd_per_compute_second.description: Compute-time billing rate for upscalers (e.g. ESRGAN).

outpaint_usd_per_megapixel.description: Cost per megapixel for outpaint — flat number or {first_mp, extra_mp} ladder.

examples.description: Example cost estimates keyed by resolution string.

ModelSupports.description: Capability flags and limits for this model.

t2i.description: True if the model supports text-to-image generation.

edit.description: True if the model supports image editing with a reference image.

image_sizes.description: Supported named or pixel image sizes.

custom_size.description: True if arbitrary width/height can be specified.

max_custom_edge_px.description: Maximum pixels allowed on any single edge when using custom_size.

max_reference_images.description: Maximum number of reference images accepted (0 = none).

negative_prompt.description: True if the model accepts a negative prompt parameter.

quality_tiers.description: True if the model accepts a quality/tier parameter (low/medium/high).

num_images_max.description: Maximum number of images that can be requested in a single call.

guidance_scale_range.description: Min and max valid guidance scale values [min, max].

prompt_expansion.description: True if the model supports/applies automatic prompt expansion.
